tools.name: search
tools.description: Search Staylong's Thailand long-stay content: visa guides, rules, 150 FAQs, nationality pages, place guides, immigration offices and tools. Returns ids for the fetch tool.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Get the full text of a Staylong document by id from search (e.g. 'guide:tm30-thailand', 'place:chiang-mai-nimman', 'office:phuket-town').

tools.name: get_visa_rules
tools.description: Current thresholds for a Thai long-stay visa (money, age, income, fees, stay length) from Staylong's live rules table, each with effective date, official source URL and confidence. Tracks: dtv, education-visa, retirement-visa, o-a-visa, ltr-visa, thailand-privilege, marriage-visa, work-visa.

tools.name: check_visa_eligibility
tools.description: Score every Thai long-stay visa (DTV, ED, retirement, O-A, LTR, Privilege, marriage, work) against a person's age, purpose, savings, income and assets, using current rules. Amounts in THB except assets in USD.

tools.name: find_immigration_office
tools.description: Find the immigration office for a Thai city, area or coordinates, with address, hours, services and tips for 90-day reports, extensions and TM30.

tools.name: list_places
tools.description: List Staylong's long-stay places (neighbourhoods, towns, islands) with who each suits, cost level and immigration office. Filter by city or by what the person wants.

tools.name: find_providers
tools.description: List language schools, Muay Thai camps, Thai cooking and massage schools and visa agents in a Thai city with Staylong's verification status (verified, contacted, unverified).

tools.name: list_rule_changes
tools.description: The latest changes to Thai long-stay visa rules logged by Staylong, newest first, with dates.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "fetch" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.
